requirement: The system shall allow a registered user to reset a password using a verified email address.
The application should load quickly and show appropriate results.
The payment service shall return a confirmation within 3 seconds after a successful card payment.
The system shall disable a user account after 5 failed login attempts within 10 minutes.
The system shall allow users to upload profile images up to 5 MB in PNG or JPEG format.
The application may store logs when necessary.
The session shall expire after 5 minutes of inactivity.
The session shall not expire before 30 minutes of inactivity.
A registered user shall be able to recover the account password using the verified email address.
Administrators shall receive an alert within 60 seconds when a monitored service becomes unavailable.
